For founders: a coach and a chief of staff in one app

A founder coach helps a founder decide what matters, act on it and recover from hard weeks. A Player Mode gives founders that coaching plus the follow-through of a chief of staff: one priority a day, dropped follow-ups caught, and a plan that holds across days.

Quick answer

For founders, every decision lands on you and follow-ups slip. A Player Mode takes that off your plate: one priority a day, dropped follow-ups caught, and coaching one question at a time, from $9.99/month for the first 100 members.

Best for: Founders, entrepreneurs and operators with equity who have more inputs than hours and no chief of staff.

Is an AI coach a replacement for a founder coach or CEO coach?

It replaces the daily part, not the person: a human coach brings judgement in scheduled sessions; A Player Mode is there every morning.

Executive coaches commonly charge hundreds to thousands of dollars per session. A Player Mode's Executive Roundtable is $24.99 a month, and the first 100 members pay $9.99. It is not a coaching service or therapy: it plans, follows up and coaches you through the day, and many founders use it between sessions with a human coach.

What is the Billionaire High Performance Coach Track?

It is a Track for people playing an ownership game: founders, and operators who hold equity.

  • Ownership and compounding outrank linear income; linear effort gets the question "does this scale without you?"
  • The Billionaire Decision Filter weighs choices on asymmetric upside, downside containment and leverage over labor.
  • High-Pressure Coaching comes pre-selected for this Track, one tap to confirm, never forced.

It is the app version of Billionaire High Performance Coach OS, which you can also install into your own AI for $49 once.

What about founder burnout?

A Player Mode is built so a bad week does not break the plan: after a miss it shrinks the next day instead of adding catch-up.

The Recovery mode gives a minimum day with no catch-up and no guilt, and the Resilience Track protects recovery capacity so a volatile season never breaks continuity. A Player Mode does not provide medical or psychological advice and is not a substitute for a licensed professional.

Frequently asked questions

How is A Player Mode different from an accountability app?

Most accountability apps track whether you did a habit. A Player Mode plans the day with you, catches dropped follow-ups, and changes how it coaches you with one tap. Its Accountability Partner role works across days: Never Miss Twice, and a minimum day after a miss, instead of a broken streak.

Does it work for operators with side projects?

Yes. Operators with side projects are one of the groups it was built for: the job that gets you promoted, plus the thing you are building. It puts real work first and keeps each project in its own lane.

What does it cost for a founder?

The first 100 members get Executive Roundtable at $9.99 a month, and it stays $9.99 while they stay subscribed. After that, Executive Roundtable is $24.99 a month, Executive Suite $39.99 and Autopilot $79.99. Billionaire High Performance Coach OS is $49 once.
